r0089: FOR THESE REASONS, THE COURT UNANIMOUSLY
r0090: 1.  Declares admissible the complaint under Article 6 § 1 of the Convention concerning the lack of independence and impartiality of the İstanbul National Security Court (*cour de sûreté de l’Etat*);
r0091: 2.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 6 § 1 of the Convention as regards the complaint concerning the lack of independence and impartiality of the İstanbul National Security Court (*cour de sûreté de l’Etat*);
r0092: 3.  Holds that it is not necessary to examine the other complaints under Article 6 of the Convention;
r0094: (a)  that the respondent State is to pay the applicant, within three months from the date on which the judgment becomes final according to Article 44 § 2 of the Convention, the following amount, to be converted into Turkish liras at the rate applicable at the date of settlement: EUR 3,000 (three thousand euros) in respect of costs and expenses, plus any amount that may be chargeable in respect of value-added tax or any other taxes payable at the time of payment, less EUR 630 (six hundred and thirty euros) received by way of legal aid;
r0095: (b)  that from the expiry of the above-mentioned three months until settlement simple interest shall be payable on the above amounts at a rate equal to the marginal lending rate of the European Central Bank during the default period plus three percentage points;
r0096: 5.  Dismisses the remainder of the applicant’s claim for just satisfaction.
r0097: Done in French, and notified in writing on 7 November 2002, pursuant to Rule 77 §§ 2 and 3 of the Rules of Court.
